messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Why are your pockets all
full? {01 01 00}{07 00 00}I was gonna give you a
cool prize for finding me.
But there's no use if you
can't carry it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Miks su taskud on täiesti
täis? {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Tahtsin sulle anda
lahedat auhinda leiu eest.
Aga pole mõtet, kui sul
pole kuhugi panna, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}You really ought to
leave a little room in your
pockets when you go out.
{07 06 00}I can't give you the prize
I was planning on giving
you,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Sa peaksid tõesti
jätma veidi ruumi oma
taskutesse, kui välja lähed.
{07 06 00}Ma ei saa sulle anda
auhinda, mida plaanisin
anda,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I guess I ought to reward
you with some sweet moolah
or something!
{07 00 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} but I guess your
pockets are full.{01 00 00 14 00} Too bad
for you,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vist peaksin sulle andma
natuke magusat raha
või midagi!
{07 00 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} aga vist on su
taskud täis.{01 00 00 14 00} Kahju
sinust,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
